evidence: Modifies src/node/blockstorage.cpp (+194/-30) and blockstorage.h to add resumable file reobfuscation for blk*.dat and rev*.dat files.
rationale: Provides a crash-safe, resumable migration tool to obfuscate existing block files without requiring operators to redownload the blockchain. While this protects pre-v28 nodes against antivirus false positives and file deletion, it addresses an existing migration gap that is reasonably deferrable.
